name: brightline-ap
description: Scripts the Brightline accounts payable team runs on invoice exports.

scripts.check:py: cd py && uv run pyright && uv run ruff check
scripts.vendors:py: cd py && uv run python -m brightline_ap.list_vendors
scripts.due:py: cd py && uv run python -m brightline_ap.due_by_friday
scripts.reconcile:py: cd py && uv run python -m brightline_ap.reconcile
